question: Does frozen STATE-S1 F4 Balanced Dual-Channel Ladder materially improve static Rest/Listening/Current Opportunity/Speaking readability in the exact PKT-STAGE-CORE-02 Stage without turning state into rank/status, weakening ensemble presence, changing selection meaning or disturbing the incumbent visual hierarchy?
single_variable: static cone state salience expressed only through relative envelope luminance and internal-core contrast
excluded_variables: cone geometry, taper, blur, falloff or vertical scale
names, state labels, pips or identity cues
right rail, Observed Cues or arc semantics

state_assignment.wren_note: The incumbent label is SELECTED, but interaction law requires selection to leave the cone materially unchanged; Wren therefore uses the Rest optical signature while selection chrome remains untouched.

source_ladders.pair_semantics: Each pair is [envelope_alpha, core_alpha] from the frozen STATE-S1 method; CREF is the historical static calibration control and F4 is the sole provisional survivor.

full_stage_geometry.geometry_law: These polygons are the frozen STATE-S1 incumbent-measured cone envelopes translated from the 1075x320 optical crop into full-master coordinates. They are masks only and create no vector production-token authority.

construction_method.input: Exact Drive-recovered PKT-STAGE-CORE-02 master bytes only.
construction_method.color_space: Decode sRGB to linear RGB, apply a scalar luminance gain identically to R/G/B, then encode to sRGB; this preserves hue direction rather than authoring new palette values.
construction_method.geometry: No resampling, inpainting, warping, generation or replacement of the existing cone pixels is allowed.
construction_method.state_gain: For each Character, envelope and core gains are F4 divided by CREF for that Character's frozen state assignment.
construction_method.listening_identity: Dr. Voss and Keir have envelope/core gains of exactly 1.0 and therefore remain pixel-identical controls inside their beam masks.

mask_and_core_weight_law.trapezoid_coordinates: For a pixel y between each polygon top and bottom, linearly interpolate the left and right polygon edges; normalize x to xn=(x-center)/half_width and y to t=(y-top)/(bottom-top).
mask_and_core_weight_law.edge_feather: Horizontal mask weight is 1 for |xn|<=0.92 and linearly falls to 0 at |xn|=1.0.
mask_and_core_weight_law.top_feather: Vertical mask weight rises linearly from 0 at t=0 to 1 at t=0.04.
mask_and_core_weight_law.floor_pool_protection: Vertical mask weight remains 1 through t=0.86 and linearly falls to 0 at t=1.0, preserving the floor-pool/anchor relationship rather than reopening it.
mask_and_core_weight_law.combined_mask: mask=edge_feather*top_feather*floor_pool_protection; all pixels with mask=0 remain exact incumbent bytes.
mask_and_core_weight_law.core_profile: Use normalized bbox coordinates xnorm=(xn+1)/2 and t. Let r=sqrt(((xnorm-0.5)/0.56)^2+((t-0.72)/0.56)^2). Core weight is 1 at r=0, linearly reaches 0.32 at r=0.48, linearly reaches 0 at r=1, and is 0 beyond r=1.
mask_and_core_weight_law.rounding: Linear-RGB output is clipped to [0,1], encoded to sRGB and rounded to the nearest uint8 value.

must_be_exact: all pixels outside the five frozen beam polygons or with zero mask weight
must_remain_semantically_unchanged: floor pools and floor/name interaction hinge

required: Dr. Voss and Keir beam polygons remain pixel-identical
all changed pixels are inside Marlowe/Wren/Iona nonzero salience masks
no changed pixel enters shell, right rail, performance/history, controls, footer, labels, pips or floor-pool protection zones
challenger and side-by-side board receive immutable hashes before subjective scoring
construction_preflight.technical_failure_law: A construction artifact or preservation failure rejects that technical attempt before scoring. It may be repaired only by conforming the implementation to this already-frozen algorithm; no F4 value, gain ratio, mask law, geometry or evaluation criterion may change.

evaluation_criteria: F4 must materially improve static distinction among Rest/Listening/Current Opportunity/Speaking in the real five-Character Stage.
Rest/Selected-Wren must remain visibly alive in the ensemble and must not read as inactivity or demotion.
Listening must remain readable receptive presence rather than merely a dimmer non-speaker state.
Current Opportunity must read as may-act salience without obligation, rank, promise of speech or creator selection.
Speaking must intensify the same carrier without erasing neighbors or dominating the entire Stage.
The integrated ladder must avoid reading as a software meter, social rank staircase or generic status brightness scale.
The incumbent Character hue/texture/background identity and floor/name interaction hinge must remain materially intact.
F4 must not increase competition with Production/Scene context, performance text, creator controls or the right rail.
Promotion requires a material net improvement over PKT-STAGE-CORE-02; parity or mixed tradeoff retains the incumbent.

decision_law.failure_consequence: Retain PKT-STAGE-CORE-02 and close the F4 comparison; do not open F4b, change gain ratios, or author another state ladder in this gate.
decision_law.promotion_consequence: Promote only the bounded static state-salience visual successor. No palette, motion, production-token, implementation, rail, identity-cue or ODR authority is created.

next_action: Commit and host-validate this preregistration, then construct the deterministic challenger from the exact incumbent bytes under this frozen algorithm. Do not score until construction preservation checks and immutable challenger/comparison hashes are complete.
